DATA ENGINEER  
 Locations: Atlanta, GA (30 Ivan Allen) OR Birmingham, AL (The Energy Center) 
 Onsite 4 says/week and one day remote 
 JOB SUMMARY:     
 The Electric Operations Technology Solutions (EOTS) Data Engineer is responsible for building, operationalizing, and maintaining data pipelines to support data, analytics, and AI use cases across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. The role involves translating data into consumable formats, supporting various data integration styles (e.g., virtualization, replication, streaming), and ensuring data reliability and scalability.  
 The data engineer will lead standardization of data curation, data taxonomy and solution delivery across the Electric Operations Technology Solutions Organization for the Databricks and Azure environments.  The position is on the Electric Operations Technology Solutions Leadership Team engaging in strategic delivery of business solutions supporting multiple business areas within Southern Company.  
 Onsite 4 days per week/ 1 day per week remote 
   
 JOB REQUIREMENTS:  (Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills )   
  Experience and Knowledge: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, or related field  

 9+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles 

 Experience with batch and real-time data processing frameworks 

 Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, HIVE, Spark) 

 Experience with AI/ML solutions in Python 

 4+ years with on-prem tools (e.g., MSBI, Informatica, Oracle Golden Gate, SQL Server) 

 2+ years with Microsoft Azure tools (e.g., Data Lake, Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse, Power BI) 

 Experience with containerization (e.g., Docker, OpenShift) 

  
 Skills: 
 Proficiency in data modeling, access, storage, and quality tools 
 Familiarity with Agile, DevOps, CI/CD methodologies 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills 
 Ability to lead and mentor others 
 Familiarity with performance optimization and data governance 
 Proactive in sharing knowledge and best practices 

 Hands-on expertise with Databricks, SQL, Python, and Apache Spark. 

 Proficiency in data modeling for analytics and machine learning. 

  
 MAJOR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:   Specify major duties performed by the job and % of time spent on duties.  
   Design and develop methods to process structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data using batch and real-time techniques 
 Develop release pipelines to automate build, version control, and deployment tasks 
 Build and maintain reusable templates, code libraries, and semantic models 
 Establish gatekeeping and guard rail processes for production data promotion 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams including data, business, and technical stakeholders 
 Promote data reusability and modular data product delivery 
 Define and enforce data quality and integrity controls 
 Provide technical guidance to less experienced data engineers 
 Optimize performance using parallel processing and minimal data movement 
 Stay current with data technologies and share insights across the organization 
 Standardize, design, and develop Databricks applications, data integrations and automated business processes. 

 Integrate data from multiple systems, databases, APIs, and business applications. 

 Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and support for business users and fellow data engineers. 

 


 
 About Southern Company 

 Southern Company (NYSE:  SO ) is a leading energy provider serving 9 million customers across the Southeast and beyond through its family of companies. Providing clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy with excellent service is our mission. The company has electric operating companies in three states, natural gas distribution companies in four states, a competitive generation company, a leading distributed energy solutions provider with national capabilities, a fiber optics network and telecommunications services. Through an industry-leading commitment to innovation, resilience and sustainability, we are taking action to meet customers' and communities' needs while advancing our goal of net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050. Our uncompromising values ensure we put the needs of those we serve at the center of everything we do and are the key to our sustained success. We are transforming energy into economic, environmental and social progress for tomorrow. Our corporate culture has been recognized by a variety of organizations, earning the company awards and recognitions that reflect Our Values and dedication to service. To learn more, visit  www.southerncompany.com . 



 
 



 
 Southern Company invests in the well-being of its employees and their families through a comprehensive total rewards strategy that includes competitive base salary, annual incentive awards for eligible employees and health, welfare and retirement benefits designed to support physical, financial, and emotional/social well-being. This position may also be eligible for additional compensation, such as an incentive program, with the amount of any bonus/awards subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan(s). A summary of the benefits offered for this position can be found here https://seo.nlx.org/southernco/pdf/SOCO-Benefits.pdf . Additional and specific details about total compensation and beneﬁts will also be provided during the hiring process.
